resonara/Month.title: Month
resonara/Month.content:
The inhabitants of Resonara have reasoned out ten months in the calendar year.

Primen
Verdane
Avenyl
Seravene
Meylis
Meridane
Harkan
Rhovan
Greymark
Dirgesong

There are four Seasons in the year.

resonara/Resonara.title: Resonara
resonara/Resonara.content:
In the In the beginning, there was silence, an infinite void without form or meaning… then from the silence came a sound, later to be known as the First Ringing, an event that shaped the void into form and silence into song.


“In the beginning, there was silence. Then came the Ringing.”
The Book of First Sounds, Chapter 1

The inhabitants of Resonara believe themselves to be echoes of that first great tone, reverberations of divine sound given physical form.
Everyone wants to know where they came from… and all of Resonara’s searching. With monumental research effort from the Great Library, knowledge is slowly returning to the realm.
Are you curious as to the research on The Conductor? The Ten Voices?
While we don’t know The Ringer, this primordial bell-tone is the origin of all existence in Resonara.

resonara/Season.title: Season
resonara/Season.content:
Due to the celestial nature of Resonara, and it’s relation to it’s two satellite moons, Sonderr and Ekko, as well as it’s relation to Sol, the world’s seasons are as follows:
Spring:

Primen
Verdane
Avenyl

Summer:

Seravene
Meylis
Meridane

Fall:

Harkan
Rhovan
Greymark

Winter:

Dirgesong

resonara/Ten-Voices.title: Ten Voices
resonara/Ten-Voices.content: According to creation texts, the Ten Voices answered the First Ringing. These voices became the foundation of the calendar, each of the ten Months honors one of these primordial responders.
